settings.title: Materials
settings.content: Made with pet-safe, easy-clean materials chosen for everyday use. See the product description above for item-specific details.

settings.title: Dimensions & fit
settings.content: Size and fit details are listed in the product description. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for comfort.

settings.title: Care instructions
settings.content: Most Mavilo products rinse clean with warm water or wipe down with a damp cloth. Check the description for item-specific washing guidance, and air-dry fully before the next use.

settings.title: Shipping information
settings.content: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days. U.S. delivery typically takes 7–15 business days, and tracking is emailed as soon as your order ships. Free U.S. shipping on orders over $50.

settings.title: FAQ: Will this work for my pet?
settings.content: Our products are designed for everyday use with most dogs and cats. Check the size guidance in the description, and feel free to contact us with your pet's details — we're happy to help you choose.

settings.title: FAQ: What if it doesn't work out?
settings.content: We offer 30-day returns on unused items in original packaging. If anything arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us and we'll make it right with a replacement or refund.

settings.heading: Clear expectations before checkout
settings.text: We ship within the United States. Orders are processed in 1–3 business days and typically arrive in 7–15 business days. Free shipping on all orders over $50. Returns accepted within 30 days on unused items in original packaging.
